items.title: Wendell Harrison interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 10, 2022 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Lonnie Hillyer, Roy Brooks and those guys was in high school — they was like two years ahead of me.

ctx.x: Lonnie Hillyer, Roy Brooks and those guys was in high school — they was like two years ahead of me. But every — like 7:30 in the morning they would be playing in the boiler room. This was back in the 50s. Because jazz wasn’t allowed to be played in the band room because the band director was nervous. He couldn’t stand to hear Charlie Parker’s work. “Cherokee” and “Donna Lee” and all that stuff. And these guys was playing the carbon copy of the record you know.
They were learning by ear, is that right?
